coordinates.origin: Airborne mounting origin at (0,0,0), vertically below trunk center. No floor-contact requirement.

concept.reason: Original specimen/Xray/line drawing plus actual hair/caudal figure suffice.

scope: Complete small furry gliding mammal, membrane visibly linking forelimb/body/hindlimb on each side, long slender tail. Not bat, flying squirrel copy or flat fossil plaque.

scale.tail_status: Model estimate; long flattened caudal anatomy supported, exact complete length not measured here.
scale.spread_status: Reconstruction choice, not direct specimen measurement.
scale.note: 17 cm is approximate restored span; claw-tip span is measured separately in QA, not presented as fossil measurement.

diagnostic_targets: Broad low-aspect membranes with real shallow thickness and smooth joins from outstretched forelimbs along body to hindlimbs. Never floating separate flags.
Small elongated trunk, distinct deep insectivorous muzzle, all four elongated limbs and short clawed digits. No exaggerated bat fingers.
Long slim slightly dorsoventrally flattened stabilizing tail, not squirrel plume or beaver paddle.
Short fur appearance over trunk and membrane via restrained geometry/material, not naked translucent bat wings.
Readable body thickness in side view and distinct head/limbs/tail in top view.
Neutral muted brown coat. No decorative stripes, ears or pigmentation presented as preserved fact.
uncertainties: IVPP V14739 is compressed with incomplete counterpart; complete membrane attachment contours and living body depth reconstructed.
Hair impressions are real, but modeled coat color, ear outline, pose and tail-tip contour are uncertain.
Do not claim articulated intact skull; original Figure1d is skull reconstruction.
Original2006 age range disputed; later IVPP2017 source places it in Jurassic Yanliao biota. Do not repeat obsolete exact130Ma.
Hindlimb-to-tail membrane extent is not fixed by the available figure; if used keep modest and explicitly inferred, never cover entire tail as colugo sheet.
acceptance: Whole-organism glider retained with bilateral fore-to-hind membrane continuity.
Solid shallow membrane avoids zero-thickness/holes and self intersections.
No bat finger wings, oversized fur plume, feather wings or planar plaque.
ExactGLB four views and self-contained two-build reproducibility then independent QA.
profile: palette-only static opaque closed-component low-poly reconstruction
normal_style: Deliberately faceted closed meshes; no transparency, textures, rig or animation.
